name: webapp-fixer
label: Repair the web app
description: The one fixer of a web app on this machine: run by recovery (core/webapp/coordinator) once per failure no learned handling knows. Its input is a webapp.fix_request.

exe_data.prompt: Use the setup-fixer skill. Your input folder holds a webapp.fix_request: the web app, its folder, the typed failure (phase, code, fingerprint, text) and what recovery already tried. Repair what the failure stands on, then record what you learned with `flow app handling add <app> --fingerprint <fingerprint> --action <action> [--arg ...]` so the next occurrence is handled by code, and write the why in the app's setup/recovery.md. Do not start or open the app yourself: recovery checks it again after you, and that check is the proof.
